parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of plastic with a printed world map on its surface. It is the main visual and interactive component of the globe.
parts.Functional_description: The sphere represents the Earth and can rotate around its axis to display different regions. It serves as the educational and visual core of the globe.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate smoothly around its tilted axis, supported by the base structure.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the globe, usually made of wood or metal, providing stability and support for the rotating sphere.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the axis and supports the globe, ensuring it remains upright and balanced during rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable foundation for the rotating sphere.
